{
 "path": "programs/task-577c8928.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if not ones or not twos:
        return out
    r,c = ones[0]
    tr,tc = twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    # Draw a diagonal ray from 1, then continue straight along the longer axis,
    # stopping immediately before the 2.
    while r + dr != tr and c + dc != tc and dr and dc:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if dr and (not dc or abs(tr-r) >= abs(tc-c)):
        while r + dr != tr:
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
        while c + dc != tc:
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        while c + dc != tc:
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
        while r + dr != tr:
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
"
}
